answer: Three leasing companies pass lease equity to the customer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co. Lease equity is the amount by which our offer is higher than the lease buyout. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay it to the customer; it puts the equity toward the car they buy from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all, so there's no equity to pass on. Two notes: Crescent has only allowed third-party buyouts since February 1, 2026, and since that same date Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.
